items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: Playing bass in an ensemble at the college that I went to with David Garibaldi, the first time I really felt a solid groove.

ctx.x: Every gig. There’s no one gig. I mean there’s some where you play with better people than others but every gig is important. Every gig that I play and have ever played is using everything that I’ve been learning up to that point. Because you’re always trying to make the best music that you can. Of course I mean there’s like a whole series of things. When I was a kid just being able to go and sing at that jazz camp. That was huge for me. That was life changing.
